personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean structure with 4 Tactile/Playful colorful solid tiles
personality_one_liner: A clean, modern hub that balances a highly functional, minimalist UI with 4 distinct, vibrantly colored solid entry points.

spacing.rule: Generous margins to support the clean aesthetic. 2x2 grid should have md gap and lg outer padding. Avoid cramming elements.

do's: Use glass on the sticky top header of the Public Channel social feed.
Use glass for the bottom transport control bar in the Looper Studio.
Apply glassmorphism to floating action buttons (FABs).
dont's: Do not use glass on the 4 main home tiles; they must be solid abstract colors.
Do not blur individual chat bubbles.

screens.name: Login

states.error: Inline red text below input + subtle haptic shake.

screens.layout: Large display title top-aligned with ample whitespace. Single column input (Email or Phone), large brandPrimary pill button. KeyboardAvoidingView used.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Hub dashboard containing the 4 main entry points.
screens.layout: Header with 'Hub' display text and Settings gear icon. Below, a 2x2 grid (flexWrap: 'wrap', space-between) containing 4 large square touchable cards (width ~48% to fit nicely with gaps). Each card uses one of the 4 defined solid tile colors (tile1 to tile4), completely borderless and flat, featuring a large icon and text at the bottom left.

screens.name: Chat with AI

states.empty: Greeting from AI: 'How can I help you create today?'
states.error: Message failed to send, tap to retry.

screens.layout: Standard chat interface. Messages from AI in surfaceSecondary, user messages in brandPrimary. Sticky input area at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Studio
screens.purpose: Looper music studio to record, stack tracks, and control volume/tempo.

states.empty: 4 empty track rows saying 'Tap to record track'.

screens.layout: Vertical list of track rows. Each row has a record/play/mute toggle and a volume slider. A fixed glassmorphic bottom bar contains the global transport controls (Play All, Stop, Master Tempo Slider).

screens.name: Musical Notes
screens.purpose: Hum to detect notes or type a song for chords.

states.error: Could not detect notes. Try again.

screens.layout: If 'Record': Large central microphone button with expanding ripple rings. If 'Type': Form with text input for song name, dropdown for instrument, and a primary CTA. Results displayed in a flat surfaceSecondary card.

screens.name: Public Channel
screens.purpose: Shared social feed where users post.

states.empty: No posts yet. Be the first to share!
states.error: Failed to load feed. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Scrollable vertical list of cards. Each card has a user avatar, name, text/content, and action row (Like, Comment). Glassmorphic top header. Floating Action Button (FAB) at bottom right to compose a post.

screens.name: Settings
screens.layout: Standard iOS-style list rows grouped in surfaceSecondary rounded containers. Includes a Switch for Dark/Light mode and a destructive red text row for Logout.

login_hero.alt: Abstract vibrant color blur gradient used as subtle header background in Login.

studio_empty.alt: Modern audio mixer used as subtle backdrop for Studio empty state.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load 'Outfit' for headings/display and 'Figtree' for body/text. Ensure all text falls back gracefully if fonts fail.

The Home screen is a Stack root (no bottom tabs), relying entirely on the 2x2 grid of 4 large solid-colored tiles for navigation. The 4 custom colors (tile1-tile4) MUST be used as the background of these cards to fulfill the 'abstract solid' requirement.
Implement the theme toggle in Settings. Default to light mode but respect the device preference initially. The color scheme provides distinct hexes for both light and dark modes.
Ensure the Studio looper interface uses a sticky bottom bar for global controls (Play, Stop, Tempo). Do not let it scroll with the tracks. Use `expo-glass-effect` (or `expo-blur`) for this bar.
Never use indigo, blue, purple, violet, or orange. Stick to the provided palette (Emerald, Ochre, Crimson, Sage) and monochrome neutrals.
Ensure all text inputs (OTP, Song Name, AI Chat input) are wrapped in a properly configured KeyboardAvoidingView with appropriate vertical offset.
